description: This file defines a feature for adding an article to favorites, including command validation and request handling logic. It uses MediatR for request/response, Entity Framework Core for data access, and custom error handling.

classes.name: Add
classes.description: Encapsulates the command, validation, and handler for adding an article to favorites.

classes.name: Add.Command
classes.description: Data record representing the command to add an article to favorites, identified by its slug.

classes.name: Add.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the provided slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Add.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the logic of adding an article to favorites, including data validation, existence checks, and database updates.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to add an article to favorites, returning the updated article envelope.
